text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Trainer Kiryuin and Trainer Kashimoto 
stayed closer to their Umamusume than ever 
before, and because of that, their girls 
began to hit their stride.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the support of Darley Arabian and 
Trainer Kashimoto, Little Cocon continued 
to sharpen her weapons even further.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Throughout the history of Umamusume, a 
Trainer has always been by their side. 
That fact was etched into their heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as if praising the Umamusume for 
facing forward and running once more, an 
invitation to the "SWBC" arrived for each 
of them.
